please use this form.

gameAccess.description: Always be able to make new games, even when the bot is under high load!

servers.title: Premium Servers

signIn: Sign in to view your servers

status.changingTiers: Each purchase starts a new PayPal subscription, so buying here won't replace the current one, and its remaining days don't carry over. If you're changing tiers, <cancel>cancel the current subscription</cancel> first.
status.ending: {{server}} has AutoMuteUs {{tier}} until {{date, datetime}}. Its PayPal subscription is cancelled and won't renew.
status.endingInherited: {{server}} has AutoMuteUs {{tier}} until {{date, datetime}}. The PayPal subscription of the server it inherits premium from is cancelled and won't renew.
status.renews: {{server}} has AutoMuteUs {{tier}}. Its PayPal subscription renews around {{date, datetime}}.
status.renewsInherited: {{server}} has AutoMuteUs {{tier}}. The PayPal subscription of the server it inherits premium from renews around {{date, datetime}}.
status.days_other: {{server}} has AutoMuteUs {{tier}}, with {{count}} days left on its latest payment.

subtitle: Looking to upgrade your Among Us gameplay even further? Running into limitations with the bot while it's under high load? Consider AutoMuteUs premium to support the project as well as improve your muting experience!
